label: Loan agreement
source: Reserve Bank of India rules on fair lending, Key Fact Statements, penal charges and digital lending. Verify against current RBI directions before relying on it.

rules.title: Key Fact Statement and APR
rules.benchmark: RBI requires lenders to give a Key Fact Statement with the all-inclusive annual percentage rate (APR) before you sign.
rules.flag: No APR or Key Fact Statement, or only a 'flat' monthly rate, is against RBI rules.

rules.title: No hidden charges
rules.benchmark: Any fee not listed in the Key Fact Statement can't be charged.
rules.flag: Open-ended fees such as 'other charges as applicable' are against RBI rules.

rules.title: No foreclosure charge on floating loans
rules.benchmark: Lenders can't charge foreclosure or prepayment penalties on floating-rate loans to individuals for non-business use.
rules.flag: A foreclosure charge on a floating-rate personal loan is against RBI rules.

rules.title: Fair penal charges
rules.benchmark: Late payment can attract a reasonable penal charge, but it can't be added to the interest rate or compounded.
rules.flag: Compounding penal interest is against RBI rules.

rules.title: No harassment in recovery
rules.benchmark: Recovery agents can't harass or threaten you, contact your family or friends to shame you, or call before 8 am or after 7 pm.
rules.flag: Recovery contact at any time, or with family and references, is against RBI rules.

rules.title: No access to your phone data
rules.benchmark: Digital lenders must not access your contacts, photos, files or call logs.
rules.flag: Access to contacts or the photo gallery is against RBI digital lending rules.

rules.title: Rate changes with notice
rules.benchmark: Interest rate changes must be told to you in advance, with the option to switch or close the loan.
rules.flag: The lender changing the rate at its sole discretion is unusual.
